sentences.Jeg er butikkmedarbeider og jobber i en: I'm a shop worker and work in a grocery shop.
sentences.Jeg har mange forskjellige oppgaver i bu: I have lots of different tasks in the shop.
sentences.Noen dager rydder jeg varer på plass i h: Some days I put goods in their place on the shelves, and I have to throw out old goods.
I also have to order new goods.
sentences.Noen dager sitter jeg i kassa og tar bet: Some days I sit at the checkout and take payment for the goods.
sentences.Jeg trives i jobben, for jeg møter mange: I enjoy my job, because I meet lots of people every day.
sentences.Nesten alle kundene er hyggelige, men no: Almost all the customers are nice, but some customers don't say hello to me at the checkout, and sometimes they talk on their mobile phones.
sentences.Da blir jeg litt irritert, for det er uh: Then I get a bit annoyed, because it's rude.
sentences.I kassa på matbutikken: At the checkout in the grocery shop
sentences.Da blir det 59 kroner. Vil du ha kvitter: That's 59 kroner, then. Would you like a receipt?
